text:
Sanjay Rao: Quick gut-check — I'm proposing a 'paydown-first' approach for the inference hotpath. Idea: carve a tiny front-tier that owns request validation, routing, and KV-cache lookups so we can iterate on cache fixes and routing rules without a full monolith cutover. Low-scope, measurable impact. Thoughts?

Maria Chen: Interesting. My worry is the extra network hop on the hotpath. Do we have a p99 latency budget headroom?

Sanjay Rao: Target is +<10ms p99 overhead for colocated front-tier. Plan is to co-locate on the same host/network plane for hot traffic and only offload enriched or long-tail requests. Tradeoffs: more autoscale knobs vs smaller blast radius for changes.

Devon Park: If we extract routing, contract discipline is critical. We need explicit trace + routing headers, strict schema. Suggest header `X-RD-Route-Version: v1` and propagate trace context. Without that canaries will be noisy.

Aisha Khan: Also need telemetry gates. On day-one we should emit: `prefix_cache_hit`, `front_queue_ms`, `backend_ms` and a tag for model+quantization. Make the schema stable across rollout.

Tim O'Leary: Rollout playbook idea: feature flag + 4-step ramp (internal canary -> 5% -> 25% -> 100%) with auto-fallback to the monolith. Add a circuit-breaker that backfills to monolith on error or latency regression.

Devon Park: Session state is a blocker: current in-memory session pointers are mutated by enrichment. If we move KV ownership we need dual-write migration + reconciliation window. That adds complexity but doable.

Maria Chen: We should bench the colocated hop. Quick script: `./bench/run.sh --seq 512 --qps 200 --workload=hotpath` — baseline before any extract.

Sanjay Rao: Good. Action items from this thread: 1) spike for shim+header (owner: Devon, due: next Wed), 2) perf baseline (owner: Maria), 3) telemetry schema (owner: Aisha), 4) rollout runbook + circuit-breaker ops (owner: Tim). I'll file a short RFC follow-up.

Aisha Khan: :thumbsup: Also note billing impact if we introduce extra RPCs for every request — add a cost estimate.

Tim O'Leary: I'll draft the runbook and test the rollback steps. Will post to release-war-room once ready.

Devon Park: tiny ask: prefer header `X-RD-Trace` for trace propagation and `X-RD-Route-V` for routing version. Keeps naming concise.

Sanjay Rao: Sounds good — we'll use `X-RD-Trace` and `X-RD-Route-V`. Thanks everyone. I'll create RFC follow-up and ping owners.

arch-bot: RFC follow-up created: https://rfc.internal.redwood/3824-paydown-front-tier-spike (assigned to Sanjay).

Maria Chen: One more perf note — include 95/99 percentiles by sequence-length buckets (64/256/1024). That helps catch regressions from long contexts.

Aisha Khan: And include a sampling toggle so we can debug full traces without blowing up ingest. `sample.trace=1/1000` or dynamic sample via flag.

Sanjay Rao: OK added to action list. We'll reconvene after spike results. Thanks.
